item.title: Older meal photos stay useful
item.summary: Murph keeps a small private thumbnail of meal photos so you can revisit a meal after its full-size photo expires.
item.details: Full-size photos have a 90-day retention target. Thumbnails stay while the meal exists; deleting the meal removes its photos. Older meals gain thumbnails as they are processed, when an original photo is still available.

tryIt.label: Revisit a meal
tryIt.prompt: Look at the saved photo for my last meal and help me describe it.
